notes.title: 2021/2/20 update
notes.content: The last patch for the current version of the game. Because the current version is too "hard core" and rough, in order to let players have a better experience, developers decide to remake the game, which will take about 2-3 months. If there is a major bug in the current version, the developer will still fix it. Detailed progress can be known by Q group.

notes.title: 2021/2/19 V1.6 update
notes.content: This is the last update of the preemptive experience version. At present, efforts are being made to remake the game, prepare to make it into an open world, and support multiplayer online. Therefore, this "hard core" version will not further add content, but if there are serious bugs, it will continue to repair. In the next two to three months, the price of the new version will not change within a week.
